stem_book: Find the moment of inertia of a uniform solid hemisphere of mass M and radius R shown in figure, about an axis AA′ passing through its centre of mass (AA′ is perpendicular to the symmetry axis of the hemisphere).
reason: 'solid' and 'uniform' made explicit (key assumes a solid hemisphere).
work: I about diameter of flat face = 2MR²/5, CM at 3R/8: I_cm = 2MR²/5 − 9MR²/64 = 83MR²/320
